title: CSC-UQ PhD Scholarship (China Scholarship Council)
about: The University of Queensland and the China Scholarship Council offer joint PhD scholarships. Expressions of interest open 2 November 2026 and full applications are due 20 January 2027; applicants must first hold an offer of a place in UQ's PhD program.
requirements: Applicants must first be offered a place in UQ's PhD program
Expressions of Interest open Monday 2 November 2026
Full applications must be submitted by Wednesday 20 January 2027

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: Seniority "Doctoral" / field "Open across disciplines" → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"Applicants must first be offered a place in UQ's PhD program" → "Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying recurring themes, methodological differences, arguments, findings, limitations, and potential research gaps."
Doctoral research across disciplines → "Apply responsible practices for verification, attribution, citation awareness, confidentiality, and academic integrity when using AI in research activities."
